title: MZ A way for mouse to only be used in menu scenes, not to move in overworld ( MZ )

posts.author: VeryPeachy
posts.body:
Hey y'all! For a while I've had a beta tester talk about how they wish that they could use their mice to select buttons and scroll while in menu. I've been using a plugin by CT_Bolt that disables mouse movement, as it feels unprofessional and shows that my game is made in RPG Maker (Something that I'm trying to hide not out of shame, but just because sometimes RMMZ gets a bad rep). Does anyone know how to make it so that just mouse movement is disabled? Thanks in advance!
(Not sure if this is the right thread to post in, if not I'll be glad to change it.)

posts.author: ShadowDragon
caethyril
posts.body:
Alternatively, you could try saving this as a .js file and importing as a plugin:
JavaScript:
/*:
 * @target MZ
 * @plugindesc Disable map movement via touch controls.
 * @author Caethyril
 * @url https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/posts/1315190/
 * @help Free to use and/or modify for any project, no credit required.
 */
// Override!
Game_Temp.prototype.setDestination = function() {};

posts.author: VeryPeachy
posts.body: Hey! I've worked in both of your code (Thanks a ton btw!), but it's odd. It works when in the submenus of the menu and the battle scenes, but it doesn't work for main menu (like the area where you select items, skills, etc.). Any idea what could be causing this? Idk how to attach a video, but if it would help I could try to attach a video.

posts.author: caethyril
VeryPeachy
posts.body: Thank you so much! This totally worked!
